name: YOOAdmin
author: Rami Obeidat

sections.description:
YOOAdmin improves the default WordPress admin experience with a cleaner interface, smarter organization, and productivity-focused tools.

Designed around real-world agency, freelancer, and business workflows, YOOAdmin helps you work faster inside wp-admin without modifying WordPress core files.

Instead of replacing WordPress, YOOAdmin modernizes and reorganizes the admin experience while preserving native familiarity and compatibility.

Whether you manage one website or many, YOOAdmin creates a calmer, more organized, and more professional workspace.

YOOAdmin includes a rebuilt appearance engine designed for broad compatibility across WordPress admin screens, editors, and popular third-party plugin interfaces, with support for light, dark, and system appearance modes.

Core Features

  • Modern and clean admin workspace experience
  • Studio Hub admin theme with a customizable card-based workspace home
  • Built-in Login Security Suite with 2FA, Turnstile, rate limiting, username protection, hidden login controls, and branded account emails
  • Advanced Notification Center with banner conversion, duplicate prevention, dismissal memory, and cleanup controls
  • Focus Mode for distraction-free work
  • New dark mode engine with robust, broad coverage and light, dark, and system appearance modes
  • Workspace dashboard customization tools
  • Workspace notes and activity overview widgets (Studio Hub)
  • Modern login page customization
  • Live login page preview
  • Custom login logo and side image
  • Maintenance Mode page with branded public display and toolbar controls
  • Branding tools (logo, title, colors)
  • Admin theme settings for colors and appearance
  • Login page appearance and language controls
  • Improved Posts, Pages, Categories, and Tags views
  • Enhanced Users pages and profiles
  • Better admin menu organization
  • Security dashboard widget for YOOAdmin workspace widgets
  • WordPress admin toolbar shortcuts for maintenance and security settings without requiring Focus Mode
  • Improved frontend YOOAdmin toolbar with appearance controls
  • Translation ready with WordPress.org language support
  • Multisite compatible
  • Optional full data cleanup tool
  • No frontend impact
  • Fully reversible using WordPress hooks

Studio Hub

Studio Hub introduces a calmer, workspace-focused WordPress experience inspired by modern productivity applications.

It provides a cleaner dashboard home, customizable workspace sections, activity widgets, workspace notes, and a more focused workflow inside wp-admin.

Notification Center

YOOAdmin converts distracting plugin notices and admin banners into a cleaner and more organized notification center experience.

Built for reliability: dismissed notifications stay dismissed, duplicates are prevented, unread counts stay synchronized even on high-performance caching setups, and optional cleanup controls help keep your workspace focused and your database organized.

Important messages stay accessible while your workspace remains focused and uncluttered.

Focus Mode

Reduce clutter and stay productive.

Focus Mode simplifies the admin area by minimizing distractions and improving clarity while you work.

Login Page Customizer

Create a modern branded WordPress login page with live preview, custom logos, side images, and clean layout options.

Improve the login experience for yourself, your team, or your clients.

Branded Account Emails

YOOAdmin replaces plain WordPress account emails with branded HTML messages that use your site logo and brand colors from Branding and Login settings.

Covered messages include password reset, new-user set-password, profile email change confirmation, email-changed security notices, two-factor email codes, email-change 2FA verification, and post-recovery confirmation.

Configure email-change recovery under Settings, Login Security, Account emails.

Branding & Customization

Make WordPress feel like your own workspace:

  • Upload custom logo
  • Change colors
  • Customize workspace appearance
  • Improve client-facing admin experience

Optional Account Connection

YOOAdmin works fully without creating or connecting any external account.

You may optionally connect your website to a YOOAdmin account for account linking and status verification only.

Connecting an account does not disable or unlock core plugin features.

Privacy

If account connection is used, the plugin may communicate with yooadmin.io for verification purposes.

This may include:

  • Website URL
  • Server IP address

No personal data, visitor data, analytics, or user tracking data is collected.

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect personal data by default.

If account connection is used, website URL and server IP may be used only for verification.

YOOAdmin Plus (optional separate plugin)

YOOAdmin Plus is an optional companion plugin. It is not included in the free YOOAdmin package on WordPress.org and is not installed automatically when you activate YOOAdmin.

To use Plus:

  1. Connect your YOOAdmin account from the dashboard (optional; only if you use Plus or account-linked features).
  2. Download the YOOAdmin Plus plugin package from your account at yooadmin.io (portal login when your license is active).
  3. Install Plus manually via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or upload the files to /wp-content/plugins/yooadmin-plus/.
  4. Activate YOOAdmin Plus from Plugins or from the Studio Hub Updates widget (user-initiated only; uses the same WordPress plugin activation APIs as the Plugins screen).

YOOAdmin Lite works fully without YOOAdmin Plus. Plus adds premium extensions and features documented on yooadmin.io. No third-party plugin is activated without an explicit action by an administrator with the activate_plugins capability.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/yooadmin, or install through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. After activation, the setup wizard opens automatically.
  4. Complete the quick setup steps.
  5. Start using your new workspace.
sections.faq:
Is YOOAdmin free?

Yes. All core features included in this version are free.

Do I need to connect an account?

No. The plugin works fully without any connection.

Does it modify WordPress core files?

No. YOOAdmin uses standard WordPress hooks and can be removed cleanly.

Does it slow down my website?

No. It runs only inside the admin workspace and does not affect the frontend.

Can I use it on client websites?

Yes.

Does it support multisite?

Yes.

Is YOOAdmin translation ready?

Yes. YOOAdmin follows WordPress localization standards and supports community translations through WordPress.org.

Is my data tracked?

No user tracking or analytics data is collected.

Does YOOAdmin leave data behind after removal?

No. YOOAdmin includes an optional cleanup tool that can safely remove plugin settings, notifications, and custom tables.

1.6.3

Fixed: Minor bug fixes and improvements.

1.6.2

Studio Hub Dashboard

Fixed: Welcome card hover showed a leftover peach Edit control in the header instead of the intended Edit Mode action.
Fixed: Sidebar navigation could briefly disappear on page load (for example when opening Report a Bug or similar screens).
Fixed: Page scrollbar now appears when the pointer nears the page edge (custom overlay); sidebar scroll behavior unchanged.
Fixed: Medium content width could stick to the edges instead of staying centered with proper gutters across admin pages.
Improved: Asset versioning now follows file changes more reliably so UI fixes are not held back by stale admin CSS/JS caches.

Studio Hub Dark Mode

Fixed: Registration and similar settings screens kept light pastel card headers and callouts in dark mode.
Fixed: Status and role chips are preserved as compact colored pills; wide pastel banners and panels are darkened correctly instead of being treated like chips.
Fixed: Accordion and section titles that stayed too light or too thin on dark surfaces.
Fixed: Third-party dashboard widgets showed unreadable contrast — pastel error banners with light text, near-black metric figures, and white chart shells on dark cards.
Fixed: Wide light info strips kept pale backgrounds while labels were forced light, making them nearly invisible.
Improved: Dark engine contrast now applies earlier and more reliably on the Studio Hub dashboard, including late-mounted React widget content.

1.6.1

Hotfix for 1.6.0.

Fixed: Sidebar sections did not keep items after a refresh, and custom icons were not saved.
Fixed: Menu icons, page dots, and the current-page highlight appeared only after the page finished loading.

1.6.0

Focus Mode Sidebar (new)

Added: A redesigned Focus Mode sidebar with three layouts — expanded, icons-only, and hidden — selectable from Settings with a visual preview.
Added: Side flyout submenus with type-based icons, tooltips, and multi-column layouts for long menus.
Added: Overflow paging — extra items move to a second page behind a “more” control instead of a scrollbar.
Added: Live customization from the sidebar itself — drag and drop, create, rename, and delete sections, group entries, and choose icons for top-level and sub items.
Added: Sidebar layouts saved per user on the server, available on any device, with one-click reset.
Added: Full color customization from the Theme Colors page.
Added: Dedicated mobile drawer.
Improved: Refined rail visuals — engraved separators, softer icons, quieter scrollbar, and a redesigned Focus Mode toggle.

Toolbar Shortcuts

Added: Shortcuts editor in Edit Mode — reorder, change icons, show all shortcuts, and reset to defaults, saved per user.
Added: Tooltips on every shortcut icon.
Improved: A fixed number of shortcuts stays on the bar; only extras move into the overflow menu.
Improved: Overflow menu restyled to match the sidebar flyouts.
Fixed: Appearance, screen width, and language controls stay pinned and can no longer be hidden, moved, or duplicated.

Dashboard & Layout

Added: Reset and quick-add controls next to Edit Mode in the welcome card.
Added: Optional footer visibility control while in Edit Mode.
Improved: Simplified the workspace card by removing duplicate edit and reset actions.
Improved: Softer, centered copyright line across all pages.

Dark Mode

Fixed: Sidebar flyout submenus kept light colors on third-party plugin screens; brand colors can no longer override the dark sidebar palette.
Fixed: Dark Mode is recognized through every Dark Engine marker, so plugin pages no longer fall back to light navigation colors.
Fixed: Empty dark panels on plugin screens caused by legacy first-paint styling applied to loaders, overlays, and headers.
Fixed: Plugin header bars are no longer rendered as an empty card above the page content.
Fixed: Notice-only and empty page wrappers no longer render as hollow rectangles.
Fixed: White flash on page load before the adaptive pass completes.
Improved: Editor-heavy screens load noticeably faster.
Improved: Surface detection now follows real page structure instead of class-name guesses.

Compatibility

Fixed: Restored compatibility with the desktop app integration after its rename.
Improved: Header and sidebar are hidden in desktop app mode for a cleaner window.

Performance

Fixed: Database schema check for Activity and Workspace Notes could run more often than necessary; it is now version-gated.

Improved: Admin-only modules are skipped on anonymous frontend requests, reducing YOOAdmin’s per-request footprint.

Studio Hub

Studio Hub introduces a calmer, workspace-focused WordPress experience inspired by modern productivity applications.

It provides a cleaner dashboard home, customizable workspace sections, activity widgets, workspace notes, and a more focused workflow inside wp-admin.

Notification Center

YOOAdmin converts distracting plugin notices and admin banners into a cleaner and more organized notification center experience.

Built for reliability: dismissed notifications stay dismissed, duplicates are prevented, unread counts stay synchronized even on high-performance caching setups, and optional cleanup controls help keep your workspace focused and your database organized.

Important messages stay accessible while your workspace remains focused and uncluttered.

Focus Mode

Reduce clutter and stay productive.

Branded Account Emails

YOOAdmin replaces plain WordPress account emails with branded HTML messages that use your site logo and brand colors from Branding and Login settings.

Covered messages include password reset, new-user set-password, profile email change confirmation, email-changed security notices, two-factor email codes, email-change 2FA verification, and post-recovery confirmation.

Configure email-change recovery under Settings, Login Security, Account emails.

YOOAdmin Plus (optional separate plugin)

YOOAdmin Plus is an optional companion plugin. It is not included in the free YOOAdmin package on WordPress.org and is not installed automatically when you activate YOOAdmin.

To use Plus:

  1. Connect your YOOAdmin account from the dashboard (optional; only if you use Plus or account-linked features).
  2. Download the YOOAdmin Plus plugin package from your account at yooadmin.io (portal login when your license is active).
  3. Install Plus manually via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or upload the files to /wp-content/plugins/yooadmin-plus/.
  4. Activate YOOAdmin Plus from Plugins or from the Studio Hub Updates widget (user-initiated only; uses the same WordPress plugin activation APIs as the Plugins screen).

YOOAdmin Lite works fully without YOOAdmin Plus. Plus adds premium extensions and features documented on yooadmin.io. No third-party plugin is activated without an explicit action by an administrator with the activate_plugins capability.
